North was a Danish esports organization and the esports affiliate of F.C. Copenhagen and Nordisk Film, founded in January 2017. It ceased operations in February 2021, citing the COVID-19 pandemic and lack of investors as reasons for the decision. [1]

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2017
  • 2018
  • 2019
  • 2020
  • 2021
  • Show All
  • January 3rd - F.C. Copenhagen and Nordisk Film announce the creation of their esports division, North, and sign the ex-Dignitas players. [2]
  • February 8th - aizy replaces RUBINO. [3]
  • March 20th - RUBINO makes his return to Team Dignitas for their new European male squad. [4]
  • August 1st - Magisk is benched from active lineup. [5]
  • August 21st - North acquire valde. [6]
  • August 21st - Magisk is bought out of contract by OpTic Gaming. [7]
  • January 26th - ruggah is removed from the team while ave is promoted to coach the main roster. [8]
  • January 29th - North replaces cajunb with mertz. [9]
  • February 2nd - Kjaerbye signs for North, k0nfig leaves the active lineup. [10]
  • February 7th - k0nfig and cajunb join OpTic Gaming. [11]
  • August 8th - niko joins North on loan from Heroic, while mertz is loaned to the latter. [12]
  • September 27th - North bench MSL and sign cadiaN in his place as the new IGL. gade is recalled from his loan to OpTic Gaming to replace niko. [13]
  • September 28th - Heroic announce mertz signing. [14]
  • October 28th - Rogue acquire MSL. [15]
  • February 4th - North signs mithR as the coach for a trial period and part ways with ave. [16]
  • March 12th - mithR completes his trial and is signed as their head coach. [17]
  • May 2nd - JUGi replaces cadiaN and valde becomes the new team captain. [18]
  • October 11th - Heroic acquire cadiaN. [19]
  • October 11th - North acquire cajunb from OpTic Gaming, replacing valde. [20]
  • December 2nd - valde parts ways with North after being acquired by an undisclosed team, which is later revealed to be OG. [21][22]
  • January 17th - North acquire MSL from OpTic Gaming and bench JUGi. [23][24]
  • February 11th - North release mithR and sign Jumpy as their new head coach. [25][26]
  • April 26th - JUGi announces his free agency. [27]
  • May 15th - Kjaerbye is placed on medical leave, kristou is acquired on loan from AGF Esport. [28][29]
  • July 2nd - kristou returns to AGF Esport following the end of his loan to North. [30]
  • July 10th - North part ways with Kjaerbye. [31]
  • August 21st - North acquire Lekr0 from Ninjas in Pyjamas. [32]
  • September 4th - North acquire kristou from AGF Esport. He is then loaned back to AGF Esport. [33]
  • November 24th - North bench MSL and aizy and recall kristou from his loan to AGF Esport. kreaz is added on trial. [34]
  • January 16th - North part ways with kreaz following the end of his trial. [35]
  • January 19th - North sign grux. [36]
  • February 5th - North cease operations and close their Counter-Strike: Global Offensive division. As a result, their lineup is transfer listed. [1]
  • February 11th - North terminate MSL's contract by mutual agreement and he leaves the team. [37]
  • March 7th - Lekr0 is acquired by Dignitas. [38]
  • April 28th - aizy's contract with North expires. [39]
  • May 1st - gade's contract with North expires. [40]
  • May 25th - grux's contract with North expires. [41]
  • June 5th - cajunb's contract with North expires. [42]
  • June 15th - kristou's contract with North expires. [43]
